plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db, async) + Valkey 9, fast-xml-parser
domain: sources.openvibe.network (vhost in deploy/nginx: an internal-service page, the merchant opt-in pages, health and JSON 404s; the JSON API is loopback-only; README "Public host")
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy sources`: /opt/openvibe.sources, unit openvibe-sources, 127.0.0.1:4720, principal sources. On 2026-10-22, 43 of the 47 sources were enabled in production (reviews 22, hosting 5, news 4, trade 4, games 3, coupons 2, and blog, crowdfunding and deals 1 each; none failing), with 55,683 items from 4,762 fetch runs since the first on 2026-10-07; they feed OpenVibe.News, Reviews, Deals (with its crowdfunding search), Coupons, Trade, Host, Games and Blog's desks. Restore drill passed 2026-09-23.
features: source registry with terms, robots and licence notes
rss, atom, sitemap, jsonld, api, manual and crawl adapters

merchant opt-in: a signed-in merchant proves a domain by DNS TXT or meta tag, names a sitemap or product feed, and a source is created only on verification with the explicit permission in its terms note; withdrawal disables it and keeps the note; /api/v1/merchant/sources is the JSON read for Report
categories: news, blog, reviews, deals, coupons, trade, hosting, crowdfunding, games, and since contracts 0.210.0 housing, food and jobs (read from sources.source@1)
a deal feed's own offer elements kept as stated (feed@3: DealNews' price, currency, retailer, end date, category and editors' pick)
api mappings: keyed maps, where conditions and patterns, $index for ranked lists; per-endpoint timeout_ms and max_bytes
facts a feed states in prose (extract): coupon codes with the shop and expiry
polite scheduler: robots.txt, per-host spacing, conditional GET, backoff
item revisions and sticky removals with provenance
retire_after_sec: items a feed stopped showing are removed as gone_from_source (jobs, listings)
